title: Claude Haiku 5.5: Cheap API, One Price Catch
status: 2026-10-10: original script based on checked primary sources; approved Option 3 flow voice; no on-screen credits.

scenes.headline: CLAUDE HAIKU *GOT CHEAPER*
scenes.say: Claude Haiku {5.5|five point five} just got dramatically cheaper, but the headline price has one important limit.

scenes.heading: SMALL PROMPTS, *SMALL PRICE*
scenes.label: per 1M input tokens · prompts up to 100k
scenes.say: Small prompts cost ten cents per million input tokens, and fifty cents per million output tokens.

scenes.heading: USE THE *SMALL* MODEL
scenes.say: That is for tasks like summaries, lookups and sub-agents, where a bigger model might just waste money.

scenes.heading: CHOOSE THE *EFFORT*
scenes.say: You also get adjustable effort, so you can trade cost and speed for deeper reasoning.

scenes.heading: THE *PRICE CATCH*
pros: Lower cost for focused, high-volume work
scenes.say: But go over a hundred thousand prompt tokens, and both prices jump fivefold. The new tokenizer also affects your bill.

scenes.heading: MATCH MODEL TO *TASK*
scenes.say: For hard coding tasks, Anthropic's own benchmarks still favor larger models. So test your workload, not just the cheapest sticker price.
Would you try cheap sub-agents? Comment Haiku.

youtube.description:
Claude Haiku 5.5 pricing starts at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens for prompts up to 100,000 tokens. Above that threshold, the rates are $0.50 and $2.50 respectively. Adjustable effort helps balance cost and quality; the new tokenizer can change tokens consumed. Anthropic's own evaluation still favors larger models for complex coding. Announcement: October 7, 2026; verified October 10.
Source: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-haiku-5-5
